angle: Trees are connected in a secret network that defies individuality
hook: Trees Warn Each Other Of Danger
caption:
Did you know that trees can communicate with each other through an underground network of fungi? This network allows them to share nutrients and warning signals, effectively creating a forest-wide internet. But how does this network impact the way we think about individuality in nature? What do you think is the most surprising implication of this discovery?
